summary: Media management application with user upload and deletion functionality for photos and videos
architectural_notes: Backend: Motoko canister with media storage and deletion methods
Frontend: React + TypeScript with Tailwind CSS for UI
Media types: Support for both images and videos
Delete operations: Both individual and potential bulk deletion

existing_features.title: Add delete button to each media post card in the feed and profile views that allows users to remove their uploaded photos and videos
Implement confirmation dialog before deleting media to prevent accidental deletion
Remove deleted media posts from UI immediately after successful deletion without requiring page refresh
Add delete mutation hook in useQueries.ts that calls the backend deletion method and handles loading/error states

new_feature_requests.summary: Backend storage and deletion for user-uploaded media files
Frontend UI for media gallery with delete functionality
Media upload interface with image and video support
Delete confirmation dialogs to prevent accidental deletion
Add backend deletion method to permanently remove user-uploaded media (images and videos) from blob storage and associated metadata from the posts data structure
